Your First Application¶

This tutorial creates a minimal application using MyFramework.

By the end, you’ll understand:

  • how the framework is initialized

  • how components are registered

  • how components interact

  • how the main lifecycle works

Create the application¶

Start with:

#include <myframework/Application.hpp>

int main()
{
    myframework::Application app;
    return app.run();
}

An Application represents the lifetime of a framework instance.

Add a component¶

Components provide the actual application behavior:

class Renderer : public myframework::Component
{
public:
    void initialize() override
    {
        // ...
    }
};

Register it with the application:

app.add<Renderer>();

What happens when run() is called?¶

Calling run() roughly performs:

  1. Component creation

  2. Dependency resolution

  3. Initialization

  4. Main processing loop

  5. Shutdown
